 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]
    # Continue the diagonal line of color 1 away from the small pattern,
    # keeping the ray within the canvas.
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 1]
    if len(pts) >= 2:
        (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = pts[-2:]
        dr, dc = r2 - r1, c2 - c1
        r, c = r2, c2
        while 0 <= r + dr < len(out) and 0 <= c + dc < len(out[0]):
            r += dr
            c += dc
            if out[r][c] != bg:
                break
            out[r][c] = 1
    return out
